name: Volumetric Inspect
description: Check a volumetric object for the things that stop a model printing.

inputParameters.name: bounds
inputParameters.description: The box to sample over, as for the Mesh component.

inputParameters.name: angle
inputParameters.description: Overhang threshold from vertical, in degrees. Defaults to 45.

inputParameters.name: min_wall
inputParameters.description: Thinnest printable wall, in model units. Defaults to 1.6.

outputParameters.name: ok
outputParameters.description: True when nothing was found that would stop the print.

outputParameters.name: pieces
outputParameters.description: Separate solids. More than one and this is not a single part.
